newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Elec shuts Beach Pt power plant.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Elec shuts Beach Pt power plant.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co said Wednesday it shut its 485 megawatt (MW) Beach Point 1 nuclear power plant for repairs and that the unit likely would be down for two to three days.
"We are repairing a pump which was found with a defect in the impeller," said company spokesman Rick James. "The unit is expected to be down two to three days."
The impeller is part of the unit's support cooling system.

Beach Point 1 is one of two units, both rated at 485 MW, at the company's generating station in Two Rivers, Wis. The two units account for about one fourth of the company's overall generating capacity.
James said the company did not anticipate any problems meeting customer electricity demand, due in part to the mild weather forecast this week for much of the Midwest.
The Beach Point number 2 unit has been shut since October for refueling and maintenance and is scheduled to return to service in early March.
Wisconsin Electrical Power Co is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
